name: Benfontein Karoo
desc: The Benfontein Karoo flux tower is located on the Benfontein Nature Reserve outside of the town of Kimberley. It measures CO2 and water vapour exchange between Nama Karoo vegetation and the atmosphere and has been operational since February 2020.

name: Benfontein Savanna
desc: The Benfontein Savanna flux tower is located on the Benfontein Nature Reserve outside of the town of Kimberley. It measures CO2 and water vapour exchange between arid savanna vegetation and the atmosphere and has been operational since February 2020.

name: Cath Peak Grassland
desc: The Cathedral Peak Eddy Covariance Flux Tower, established in July 2014, is situated at 1935 meters above sea level in high altitude mesic grasslands in the Cathedral Peak Research Platform, Northern Drakensberg. It measures carbon dioxide and water vapour exchange between this grassland vegetation and the atmosphere.

name: Jonkershoek Fynbos
desc: The Jonkershoek flux tower monitors CO2 and water vapour exchange between natural fynbos vegetation and the atmosphere in the Jonkershoek Experimental Catchment. The station has been operational since February 2019.

name: Maputaland Coastal Cashews Grassland
desc: The Coastal Cashews grassland flux tower collects data on CO2 and water vapour exchange in a subtropical, coastal, communal grazing landscape.

name: Maputaland Umhlabuyalingana Grassland
desc: The Umhlabuyalingana grassland flux tower collects data on CO2 and water vapour exchange in a subtropical, coastal, communal grazing landscape. It has been operational since March 2023.

name: Skukuza Savanna
desc: The Skukuza savanna eddy covariance station is located in the southern Kruger National Park, a protected savanna landscape. It has been monitoring CO2 and water vapour exchange among many other variables since 2000. It is the longest operating flux monitoring site in South Africa.

name: Spioenkop Savanna
desc: The Spioenkop Savanna flux tower collects data on CO2 and water vapour exchange in a mid elevation savanna landscape on a nature reserve. It has been operational since January 2023
